Like as I’m sure you’re aware we are currently deporting British citizens for being black. We have people running around telling British citizens and people who live here to ‘go home’ and graffitiing their homes and businesses. 

We have a political group referring to people as having a ‘funny tinge’.  We have a former Foreign Secretary referring to women who wear the niqab as letterboxes.

We have people attacking people for speaking Spanish on the Tube despite the fact most British expats in Spain don’t bother to learn the language. We are about to flush the country’s entire future down the drain to keep immigrants out. My Lithuanian dentist is going home next week. 

We are about to create an entire new class of citizens even amongst white people as those with dual citizenship can move freely within the EU and those who don’t cannot. Rights taken away without permission. 

It is having an impact on people’s lives right now. And it is born out of white British people thinking they’re better than others because they once ruled the world by committing mass murder.

items.text: Instinct asked Raja if she'd do All-Winners, this is her response
Do you know her personally?

I know most of us think (probably correctly) that Jinkx would be the ultimate RPDR winner, but Raja is really good at Drag Race and has diversified her portfolio a lot since S3. I think provided she could be bothered she'd be a real threat.

She has the third-best track record of all the winners, behind Sharon and Bianca (Jinkx has a ton of highs but only actually won two challenges)

Sharon - 4 wins, 3 highs

Bianca - 3 wins, 4 highs

Raja - 3 wins, 4 highs (has a Btm2 where Bianca doesn't)

There are plenty of winners who have a much smaller platform than queens who have done AS. So that argument doesn't  necessarily hold. Like Shangie has done three seasons of Drag Race - Jinkx has done one and it was six years ago.

If the winners are the best of the best, I'd rather see that than yet another AS season - if they keep churning them out they're going to end up filling them with meh queens.
